mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_conversation (user_uuid, conversation_id, role, content, tool_name, created_at) VALUES (#{userUuid}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{toolName}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_uuid, conversation_id, role, content, tool_name, created_at FROM ai_agent_conversation WHERE user_uuid = #{userUuid} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, user_uuid, conversation_id, role, content, tool_name, created_at FROM ai_agent_conversation WHERE user_uuid = #{userUuid} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1000
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_agent_conversation WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_agent_conversation WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
